From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

German

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Middle High German vriundinne, from Old High German friuntinna. Analyzable as Freund +‎ -in.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈfʁɔʏ̯ndɪn/
  • Audio (Austria):(file)
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

Freundin f (genitive Freundin, plural Freundinnen, masculine Freund)

  1. female equivalent of Freund

Usage notes

[edit]
  • Freundin (and Freund) may refer to either a platonic friend or a romantic partner. See Freund for more.

Declension

[edit]
Declension of Freundin [feminine]
singular plural
indef. def. noun def. noun
nominative eine die Freundin die Freundinnen
genitive einer der Freundin der Freundinnen
dative einer der Freundin den Freundinnen
accusative eine die Freundin die Freundinnen
